tasks.label: Export current TEX to DOCX (pandoc)
args: if ! command -v pandoc >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: pandoc is not installed. Install with: sudo apt-get install -y pandoc" && exit 1; fi; pandoc "${relativeFile}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.docx" --from=latex --to=docx --lua-filter=filters/moderncv-to-docx.lua --resource-path="${fileDirname}:${workspaceFolder}"

tasks.label: Export current TEX to DOCX (PDF route)
args: set -e; if [ "${fileExtname}" != ".tex" ]; then echo "Error: Open a .tex file before running this task."; exit 1; fi; if ! command -v xelatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: xelatex not found. Install TeX Live: sudo apt-get install -y texlive-xetex texlive-latex-extra texlive-lang-chinese fonts-noto-cjk"; exit 1; fi; OUT_PDF="${workspaceFolder}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdf"; (cd "${fileDirname}" && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${fileBasename}" >/dev/null); (cd "${fileDirname}" && xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${fileBasename}" >/dev/null); if [ ! -f "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdf" ] && [ ! -f "$OUT_PDF" ]; then echo "Error: PDF was not generated."; exit 1; fi; SRC_PDF="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdf"; if [ ! -f "$SRC_PDF" ]; then SRC_PDF="$OUT_PDF"; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: python3 is required."; exit 1; fi; python3 -c "import pkgutil,sys; sys.exit(0 if pkgutil.find_loader('pdf2docx') else 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ( echo "Installing pdf2docx locally..." && python3 -m pip install --user pdf2docx >/dev/null ); python3 -m pdf2docx.convert "$SRC_PDF" "${workspaceFolder}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.docx" >/dev/null; echo "DOCX exported: ${workspaceFolder}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.docx"
